name: Keeton Martin
intro: I'm a software engineer at [Range](https://range.com), where I've built proactive, engaging agents from scratch and led our AI financial planning and investment projects. Our agents work alongside financial advisors and talk directly with the high-net-worth households we serve.

On the side I build train trackers, tiny keyboards, and a portal for AI agents to provision their own software. Before Range I spent three years at Salesforce. I studied computer science at Haverford.
